reviewMethod: All 17 selected current-generation stored SVG files were independently rehashed against the frozen 19:28 Beijing read-only evidence snapshot. Task/page/article/source DOI, original figure identity, caption, content-addressed R2 key, dimensions/type and full SHA256 were checked. Every SVG was rendered and individually viewed on contact sheets against the owning paper title and caption. Existing deployed media and official TOCs were checked to avoid same-ID replacement or TOC/body-role confusion. No publisher recrawl, R2 write, direct import/repair or marker-only approval was used.
quality: All 17 files are preserved SVG captures. The files decoded/rendered successfully in the review environment. Figure 1 entries remain article figures and are not treated as TOCs. No cross-DOI, recommendation-content or duplicate-file conflict was observed in this bounded subset.
